selected_evidence.requirement: HAProxy serves `/` on port 80 and returns HTTP 200 with body `infraset-nodejs` while Node.js listens only on loopback port 3000.
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart checks show HAProxy owning port 80, Node.js owning only 127.0.0.1:3000, port 3000 unavailable through the node IP, valid HAProxy configuration, and the exact required HTTP response.
Shows the named unit enabled, active and running, with `/usr/bin/nodejs /opt/infraset-nodejs/server.js` as its managed process.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart and recovery evidence for node1.
selected_evidence.summary: Captures the healthy baseline and original boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered enabled services, listeners, HTTP 200 response, exact body, and loopback-only backend after restart.

set -eu
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/infraset-nodejs.service >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_SYSTEMD_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=InfraSet Node.js HTTP application
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=infraset-nodejs
Group=infraset-nodejs
WorkingDirectory=/opt/infraset-nodejs
ExecStart=/usr/bin/nodejs /opt/infraset-nodejs/server.js
Restart=always
RestartSec=2
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_SYSTEMD_UNIT
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable infraset-nodejs.service
printf 'unit_installed_and_enabled\n'
commands.stdout: unit_installed_and_enabled

--- /etc/default/haproxy ---
# Defaults file for HAProxy
#
# This is sourced by both, the initscript and the systemd unit file, so do not

After=network.target syslog.service
Wants=syslog.service

[Service]
Environment=CONFIG=/etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg

ExecReload=/bin/kill -USR2 $MAINPID
KillMode=mixed
Restart=always

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
